user.title: Sign in to Mopeka
user.description: Enter the email address and password you use for the Tank Check app.

sensors.title: Choose measurements
sensors.description: Choose which measurements to create as entities for each tank. Current values are shown in parentheses.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Mopeka again
reauth_confirm.description: Mopeka no longer accepts the saved password for {email}. Enter the password you use for the Tank Check app.

reconfigure.title: Update Mopeka sign-in
reconfigure.description: Update the email address or password for this Mopeka account.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Mopeka Cloud. Check that Home Assistant has internet access and try again. The Home Assistant log has details.
error.invalid_auth: Mopeka did not accept this email and password. Check that they work in the Tank Check app. The Home Assistant log has details.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. The Home Assistant log has details.

abort.already_configured: This Mopeka account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: These details belong to a different Mopeka account. To add another account, add the integration again.

data_description.update_interval: How often to check Mopeka Cloud for new readings, in minutes.
data_description.excluded_devices: Tanks selected here are not added to Home Assistant. Use this for tanks that the built-in Mopeka Bluetooth integration already provides.
data_description.sensors: Measurements to create as entities for each tank.
